maple.subject: Maple Auto Insurance: your week of Nov 9
maple.headline: More people booked a call this week, and your sales rose.
bullets: 32 people booked a call, up 52% from 21.
20 of the 26 people with a call due showed up, 77%, down 3 points.
maple.win: Three new policies closed for $2,800, up from $1,200 the week before.
maple.watch: Show-up rate eased a little, so we are keeping an eye on it.
maple.next_step: We are sending a text reminder two hours before each call to keep show-ups steady.

harbor.subject: Harbor Home Coverage: your week of Nov 9
harbor.headline: Leads were steady, but fewer booked people are showing up than usual.
bullets: 21 people booked a call, up 11% from 19.
13 of the 23 people with a call due showed up, 57%. The last four weeks averaged 74%.
harbor.win: Four new policies closed, up from three the week before.
harbor.watch: Show-ups have been low for two weeks in a row. Closed sales came to $2,500, down 54% from $5,450.
harbor.next_step: We are reviewing the reminder messages and call times for the last two weeks to see why people are missing calls.

summit.subject: Summit Life Advisors: your week of Nov 9
summit.headline: New leads fell sharply this week.
bullets: 4 people booked a call, down 71% from 14.
5 of the 7 people with a call due showed up, 71%, up 13 points. This comes from a small number of calls, so it can swing a lot.
summit.win: One new policy closed. Revenue is not tracked for this account, so we cannot show a dollar figure.
summit.watch: Leads are the number to watch. A drop this size usually means a lead source or form stopped working, but we have not confirmed the cause.
summit.next_step: We are checking your ad campaigns and website form today to find where the leads stopped.
